body_text:
For subspaces $U,W\leq V$, their sum is
$U+W=\{u+w:u\in U,\ w\in W\}$. The sum is direct, written
$U\oplus W$, when $U\cap W=\{0\}$. In that case every vector in
$U+W$ has a unique decomposition $u+w$.
